notes.title: A Foreign World - Episode 7.5
notes.content:
[p]Yikes. [/p][p][i]Didn't you make a post earlier today saying the update won't be out for another week because you are sick or something like that?[/i][/p][p]Who said that? I didn't say that. Surely, I wasn't just feeling sick for an hour and then got bored, so I finished the update anyway. Surely, that's not what happened.  Guys... Can we move on from that? It wasn't the best start into the morning.[/p][p]Anyway, I received the Chinese translation, and I did the German translation. This time around Swedish, and Spanish will come with a patch later on. I know some of you guys rely on it, but most play the English version, and I didn't want to keep this update on the shelve for another week before publishing it.[/p][p]Because tomorrow I'm going on vacation. And I'm telling you, publishing the update then would be out of the question. I might do some writing inspired by the sun at the mediterranean sea, but that's about it. I hope there are no game breaking bugs in  this update, because... Yeah it won't be fixed until two weeks from now. But I can ease your mind, this version of the game has been tested, so things should be fine.[/p][p]Have fun exploring this update. For once I added some spicy scenes. I know you're not used to that, but at some point A Foreign World will have to live up to its genre.[/p][p][/p][p][b][u]A Foreign World - Episode 7.5[/u][/b][/p][p]Changelog:

notes.title: New Update - Episode 7
notes.content:
[p]I thought renpy was kidding me when it told me this update was only 6,800 words long. It certainly felt like more, and after all, the Google Doc where I wrote this update had about 8000 words. There must have been a mistake or something.[/p][p]Or so I thought. After the guy who translates this game into simplified Chinese also only billed me for 6,800 words, I figured it out. Yes, the Google Doc was 8000 words long, but this also included all my comments on what's supposed to be happening on screen, with no text being shown. Things like '# The four of them on top of the slide' followed by '# Top down view of MC being the fastest, then Sue, then Monique, then Tracy'.[/p][p]And, yes, those small prompts were approximately 1,000 words. So if you are not into reading... You probably shouldn't be here... But if you are here and you are not into reading, this update might be a bit more for you than my others.[/p][p]It's the beach episode, but without the beach. But you can see the girls in swimwear. I was also told that my renders have improved, judging by this update. I'd say I just relied a bit more on the bloom filter that Daz3d offers, but maybe that's an improvement.[/p][p]Usually, I keep the text that accompanies the update brief, but I always feel compelled to write at least something.[/p][p]So, I'll leave you to enjoy Episode 7. Have fun!

notes.title: A Foreign World - Episode 6.5
notes.content:
It's that time of the year. You know what I'm trying to say. 

11,100 words, 374 renders, 23 animations... I thought it would be a small update, and it kind of wasn't. Get used to it because I doubt there will be smaller ones in the future. The story has taken up speed and there are more and more things to bring into every new coming day. 

I hope you're excited about the next update. Sneak peaks can be found on my Discord, because I did work on some environments even before this update was finished. 

Have fun exploring the update. This time there is a scene that's a bit harder to access than usual, but you guys will figure it out. I'm sure of it.

This time, the Swedish translation of Episode 6.5 will be added with a patch at a later date. I've mentioned it a couple of times. Some of my translations are made by fans, and I won't force them to work on strict deadlines. For now, the Swedish translation reaches up to the end of Episode 6, and the rest can be enjoyed in English or at a later date.

notes.title: A Foreign World - Episode 6
notes.content:
Hey everyone, 

It's time for another update. This time it's more than just a continuation of the story. There is that, don't get me wrong. 7,900 words, 331 images, and 11 animations. But besides that, I've added two things. 

First, an image gallery. This is something quite precious to me. More about this in my next New Year post. They are clumped for characters so browsing through them can be a good reminder of each individual story. The image gallery might even be better than the memory screen. You unlock each image when it is first displayed in the game. Also it's not tied to a playthrough, so you can look at them whenever you want.

Second, a replay gallery. For the longest time A Foreign World didn't need a replay gallery, since there was only one spicy scene. By now there are a few more. Actually I also added some wholesome scenes to the replay gallery. Hand holding and that kind of stuff. I know, kinky... Anyway, that means there are a bunch of scenes there and some of them even have some spice. Tell me how you like the way I handled the fact that prior choices can affect a scene. For now, I simply asked before playing a replay which choices have been made before.

Okay okay, I did some programming (I downloaded a template from Itch which made adding the two things easy). Is there something else?

Yes!

All translations are up to date. I said this might not be the case in future updates, and the statement still stands. Eventually, there will be a time when for example the German translation will lack behind one or two updates. But it won't be today. By the way, if you are a fan and want to translate the game, for example, into French or some other language, feel free to contact me. 

That's it from me. Enjoy the new update.

notes.title: A Foreign World - Episode 5.5
notes.content:
I'm a little late and a bit tired. I said I would release on Sunday, and it's currently Monday at 2 a.m. where I live. I'll keep myself short. This update changed many things. 

The most obvious is that day eleven was added. But I also went back and changed a couple of renders. I was unhappy with how Nathaniel looked, so I redesigned his model, making him look more like his age. And I also wasn't happy with how I handled Monique's invisibility, so I changed the images where she appears. She is now always only slightly visible, which is made for the viewer. In the context of the story, she actually can't be seen at all. But images where there is nothing are boring to look at, so in the renders, she distorts the light by the tiniest of margins.

I also added a fun little scene (about ten lines long) in which MC gives Monique glasses so he knows her eye level when she is invisible. I thought this would be something MC would do. 

And I'm just going to mention it already.y This isn't true for this update. It still includes all translations, but future updates might release with only the English version, and the Spanish, German, and/or Chinese translations will be added later on. Going forward, I want to keep the option open so updates won't be delayed because the only missing part is one of the translations. This hasn't happened yet, and it might not happen in the future.

Still, I wanted you to have heard about it in case I, for example, finish the next update but then fall sick and can't do the German translation for two or three weeks. Then, instead of sitting on the update, I would release it and add the German translation with a months-long delay. 

Anyway, that's all from me. I hope you enjoy the new update with all its translations.

notes.title: A Foreign World - Episode 5
notes.content:
What a hassel...

- For some people the feature to hide your in-game-interface using the 'H' Button, or the middle of your mousewheel caused problems. I tried to give these people a helping hand. At the start of every playthrough, I unhide the in-game-interface. If anybody accidentally hides the in-game-interface, it will be fixed once he starts another playthrough.
- In the Pilot Episode, MC is paving his driveway. He was using a carpenter hammer instead of a rubber hammer. People have pointed out that this doesn't make much sense, so I changed those images.
- There was an image that showed Monique at the house, even though she wasn't at the house at the time. I removed it from the game.
- The conversation at the hospital directly after MC first met Tracy and the others has been changed slightly.



I'm probably forgetting about something, but these are all the small things that changed with Episode 5. Let's get to the main topic. The new update has 318 renders. There are 16 animations, and in total, it should be around 17.300 words long. This doesn't include the memory screen.

From now on, I will use a different way to convey to you how many words an update adds/ how many words are currently in the story. This could mix up some of the numbers. My prior way of doing this was faulty. From now on, it will be more accurate. 

Using this new method, A Foreign World is currently 114,527 words long. The old way undercounted the actual number by 3.200 words. Those words haven't been added with Episode 5, they were just not counted before.

notes.title: A Foreign World - Episode 4
notes.content:
Time for another update. 

I'm proud to announce that from this day forward, A Foreign  World will be available in simplified Chinese. I was contacted by a  translator, and I thought it was a cool idea that I should try out.

Initially, I wanted to turn the added translation into its own update because why not? If I'm lucky, it's free publicity. Then, a  few days ago, I heard that my translator was about to catch up to me,  and well... here we are. I created the necessary buttons and added the translation as a new feature introduced in Episode 4. I hope this helps me reach new people, but to be honest, I also like the idea that I can say my game is available in 4 languages.

This number might go up in the future, but especially while the game is still in early access on Steam, it's bothersome to coordinate multiple people translating the new updates. For now, I'm lucky, and the people I'm working with are very reliable. But I can easily imagine a scenario where an update is delayed because I can't reach one of the translators. So, what I'm saying is that if you want the game in a specific language, then you can request it, but it might only be added shortly before the actual release.

I'm open to everything except French ;D


Those who play the game on Steam might have noticed, but with the last update, achievements no longer worked. I found the issue.  Not sure how I managed to break that, though. I just needed to reimport  Steam integration into the thing I used to create the game. This should have been it. Please tell me if there are still issues.

Other than the simplified Chinese translation, there aren't any fancy new game mechanics introduced in this update, so I don't have much to talk about.

This release is a bit over 10,000 words long and has around 240 images. I don't want to spoil anything. Go ahead and check it out yourself.

notes.title: A Foreign World - Episode 3.5
notes.content:
A new release is ready to see the light of the day.

It's always hard to determine how many words are currently in the game. That's because it's not all dialogue, but some is hidden in the memory screen or other UI elements. So, sometimes, the best I can do is to extract all translatable Strings and then run the text through a word counter program. When I do that, then we are currently at 77.100 words.

I think it is fair to say we are approaching book length.

Episode 3.5 is centered around Lucy. It adds another day to the story.

Not only that. With Episode 3.5 came a couple of other scenes that can be found in between the already existing story. They are either fantasies or memories, and they shed a bit more light on MC's thoughts.

Many of those are sexual in nature, so it might be worth taking a look.

There was a bug that appeared when the game wanted the player to enter MC's name. This now happens through a different mechanism. Hopefully, this resolves the issue. It's hard to verify because I can't recreate the bug on my end, and I'm not in close contact with someone who can. If it still appears, then please reach out to me. I will fix it and issue upload a small bug fix.


Episode 3.5 also added side images. By default, this feature should be turned off. You can enable it in the preferences tab. These side images help differentiate between who is talking. Especially in the scenes with Lucy's parents, this should be helpful.

That's all I have to say. Go ahead and enjoy this new update! Have fun!

notes.title: A Foreign World Episode 2.6
notes.content:
[i]This update still ends at the same spot as the previous release. Still, there are new scenes to discover, but they are placed between the existing story.[/i]

With that out of the way, we can come to the more personal part of this release note. How are you guys? Hope you're doing well and aren't fighting something stupid like food poisoning. Me neither, at least not anymore.

Sorry. I wanted to release this update a little sooner, but when I was right about to finish, I was knocked out for a few days. That's done now. I'm full of energy and can't wait to work on the next release (Which will feature a little more story).

Oh no, I said it. This update is just something for in-between releases that had to be done to set up a few things for the second half of Episode 3. Mainly two conversations between Amber and Tracy. Still, two exchanges wouldn't take too long to add, but when going over my old work, I can't help but try to fix a few things.

It's all connected to a broader effort of me trying to become a better writer so the story won't crumble within the next few updates. In the end, it's time good invested, even if it doesn't look that way now, seeing how long it took me to bring out Episode 2.6. Hold back your judgment for one or two releases. You'll find that the story will feel very natural. 


So, what was added in this version? This is a spoiler, so don't read this if you want to play the game and find the new details yourself. 

You have been warned. There is a new Intro that's more fitting for the type of game I'm creating. The MC's past has been fleshed out a lot more in multiple shorter scenes during the first night. The cop that shot Aurora now has another scene showing his internal struggles. Amber's language theory has been cut out from the game because it's not coherent with its internal logic. I fleshed out the backstories of each character behind the scenes, and her answer no longer made any sense. Then, there is a slight change when the girls discuss if they want to rely on MC's help. And lastly, there are the two conversations between Amber and Tracy that I've already mentioned. This sums it up quite nicely. There are one or two more minor changes, like added lines that display the thoughts of certain characters, but they are too small to all be mentioned here.
